verdict.rationale: Check ships a CLI, an MCP server and embedded Components, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no way to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The Component events in check-docs-8 are a feature for integrators to track their own users, not a user opt-out. The community report describes broad data collection and no opt-out mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
